The Chinese characters for Raymond

As a transliteration, Raymond is usually written 雷蒙德 (Léi méng dé). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Origin and meaning

With Germanic origins, Raymond is usually read as “wise protector”.

About the name Raymond

A Germanic name meaning 'wise protector', common across Europe.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Raymond as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “wise protector”, is part of the appeal.
